more_info.uses: EU permissions include chewing gum. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA could not assess food-use safety because the toxicology data were insufficient in 2018.
The former shared silicate intake limit was considered obsolete.
more_info.overview: Magnesium silicate is classified in food technology as an anti-caking agent. Its technological role is to keep powders free-flowing.
